title: The Double-Ended Eyeshadow Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: An eyeshadow brush with a large end for effortless blending and a small end for defining—it’s the only eyeshadow brush you'll ever need.

Brush Handle Length: 6.6"

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan.

What Else You Need to Know: Here to uncomplicate application, this double-ended eyeshadow brush features luxurious vegan bristles that pick up the perfect amount of product. The large end mimics your fingertips for seamless shadow application, while the small end defines, lines, smudges, and highlights with precision.

The large end—blend: Sweeps color across the lid and into the crease. The small end—define: softens, deepens, and defines the lash lines.

Research Results:
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
- Using the large end, swipe SuperSuede™ Eyeshadow (or your favorite powder eyeshadow) on the eyelid and press lightly for a soft wash of color. Blend upward toward the crease, sweeping in soft strokes until the edges fade seamlessly into the skin.
-Using the small end, add shadow to the lash line for soft definition.
